title: Stir Fry Adventure
description: A simple and delicious stir fry recipe perfect for adventurous eaters. This dish combines the savory flavors of umami with the protein-rich tofu.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the sliced bell pepper and carrot and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Return the cooked tofu to the skillet and stir in the soy sauce, umami, and sesame oil.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the tofu is coated in the sauce.
Garnish with chopped scallions and serve hot.
